verses.text: A long time passed, and the LORD gave Israel rest from all their enemies around them. Joshua was by then very old.
He called all Israel together, with their elders, leaders, judges and officers, and said to them, "I am very old now.
You have seen everything the LORD your God did to all these nations for your sake. It was the LORD your God who fought for you.
Look, I have given you the land of the nations that are still left, as well as the nations I have already defeated, to be shared among your tribes, from the Jordan to the Great Sea in the west.
The LORD your God himself will push them out ahead of you and drive them away. You will take their land, as the LORD your God promised you.
So be very strong. Be careful to obey everything written in the book of the law of Moses. Do not turn away from it to the right or to the left.
Do not mix with the nations still left among you. Do not speak the names of their gods or make promises by them. Do not serve them or bow down to them.
Instead, hold on tightly to the LORD your God, as you have done until now.
The LORD has driven out great and strong nations ahead of you. To this day no one has been able to stand against you.
One of you can chase away a thousand, because the LORD your God fights for you, just as he promised.
So be very careful to love the LORD your God.
But if you turn away and join yourselves to the people of these nations still left among you, and marry them and mix with them,

then you can be sure that the LORD your God will no longer drive these nations out ahead of you. Instead, they will become a trap and a snare for you, a whip on your backs and thorns in your eyes, until you disappear from this good land the LORD your God has given you.

Now I am about to go the way of everyone on earth. You know with all your heart and soul that not one of all the good promises the LORD your God made to you has failed. Every one has come true. Not one has failed.
But just as every good thing the LORD your God promised has come true, so he will also bring on you every bad thing he warned about, until he has destroyed you from this good land he has given you.

If you break the covenant of the LORD your God, which he commanded you to keep, and go and serve other gods and bow down to them, the LORD's anger will burn against you. You will quickly disappear from the good land he has given you."
